chunks: The virtuous and learned Shaykh, Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh al-Qummī, the author of this book—may Allah be pleased with him and grant him abode in His Paradise—said:

key_terms.اَلسَّعِيدُ: the felicitous or virtuous one; a term of praise
key_terms.اَلشَّيْخُ: the Shaykh; an honorific title for a senior scholar
key_terms.اَلْفَقِيهُ: the jurist; one deeply learned in fiqh
key_terms.رَضِيَ: may He be pleased; part of a supplicatory phrase

ai.seo_question: Who is the author introduced at the beginning of Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This opening identifies the author of the book, Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh al-Qummī, with honor and supplication for him. It serves as a biographical and introductory formula rather than a hadith text with an isnad or legal ruling.
